The vast water of the bay expands beyond the southern stone wall.  Ships of all sizes pass by the seafront as they make their way in and out of the harbor to the south. [City of Pearl, Center.]

Granting an uninhibited view of the bustling shipping industry, a stone seawall bevels out behind a long crescent bench and creates a half-moon addition to the congested crossroads at the heart of the city.  The vast water of the bay expands beyond the southern stone wall.  Ships of all sizes pass by the seafront as they make their way in and out of the harbor to the south.  The streets head in many directions, as well as a tunnel to the northeast.  At the center of the intersection is an elegantly carved monument of a giant pearl atop a tall obelisk.  The base of the centerpiece rests at the bottom of a shallow fountain that has a burning spear pointing down into the water.  A small stone sundial has been carved on the rim of the fountain.  You notice a wooden directional signpost.

Obvious Exits: southwest, southeast, northwest, northeast, west, east, and north.

[City of Pearl, Center.]

Granting an uninhibited view of the bustling shipping industry, a stone seawall bevels out behind a long crescent bench and creates a half-moon addition to the congested crossroads at the heart of the city.  The vast water of the bay expands beyond the southern stone wall.  Ships of all sizes pass by the seafront as they make their way in and out of the harbor to the south.  The streets head in many directions, as well as a tunnel to the northeast.  At the center of the intersection is an elegantly carved monument of a giant pearl atop a tall obelisk.  The base of the centerpiece rests at the bottom of a shallow fountain that has a burning spear pointing down into the water.  A small stone sundial has been carved on the rim of the fountain.  You notice a wooden directional signpost.

Obvious Exits: southwest, southeast, northwest, northeast, west, east, and north.

[Bayesian Court, Bank Entrance.]

Interlocking stone pavers, laid out in extravagant patterns, stretch out in every direction.  Iron lamp posts and transplanted dogwood trees lie evenly spread out along the plaza with flat slabs of marble serving as benches between them.  You notice an open engraved silver door.

[City of Pearl, Center.]

Granting an uninhibited view of the bustling shipping industry, a stone seawall bevels out behind a long crescent bench and creates a half-moon addition to the congested crossroads at the heart of the city.  The vast water of the bay expands beyond the southern stone wall.  Ships of all sizes pass by the seafront as they make their way in and out of the harbor to the south.  The streets head in many directions, as well as a tunnel to the northeast.  At the center of the intersection is an elegantly carved monument of a giant pearl atop a tall obelisk. You notice a wooden directional signpost.

[City of Pearl, Center.]

Granting an uninhibited view of the bustling shipping industry, a stone seawall bevels out behind a long crescent bench and creates a half-moon addition to the congested crossroads at the heart of the city.  The vast water of the bay expands beyond the southern stone wall.  Ships of all sizes pass by the seafront as they make their way in and out of the harbor to the south.  The streets head in many directions, as well as a tunnel to the northeast.  At the center of the intersection is an elegantly carved monument of a giant pearl atop a tall obelisk. [Bayesian Court, Bank Entrance.]

Along the entrance of the bank are massive stone pillars that create a lavish backdrop to the busy courtyard. [City of Pearl, Center.]

Granting an uninhibited view of the bustling shipping industry, a stone seawall bevels out behind a long crescent bench and creates a half-moon addition to the congested crossroads at the heart of the city.  The vast water of the bay expands beyond the southern stone wall.  Ships of all sizes pass by the seafront as they make their way in and out of the harbor to the south.  The streets head in many directions, as well as a tunnel to the northeast.  At the center of the intersection is an elegantly carved monument of a giant pearl atop a tall obelisk.  The base of the centerpiece rests at the bottom of a shallow fountain that has a burning spear pointing down into the water.  A small stone sundial has been carved on the rim of the fountain.  You notice a wooden directional signpost.

Also here: a disgruntled dwarf, and a well-dressed dwarf 

Obvious Exits: southwest, southeast, northwest, northeast, west, east, and north.

[City of Pearl, Coastal Route.]

[Pawnshop, Entrance.]

Sedrin's is quite possibly the busiest shop in the entire academy.  Customers come and go at all hours of the day in hopes of selling their spoils from conquests beyond the safety of the academy walls.  An iron-banded wooden barrel sits beside the door, collecting rainwater as it rolls off the roof.  You notice an iron-banded wooden barrel, and an open sturdy oak door.

Obvious Exits: north.

[Market Square East.]

The eastern end of the market is covered in heavy traffic between the academy depository to the north and Sedrin's pawnshop to the south.  Adventurers stumble through carrying as much loot as possible after a successful hunt in the outlands.  Several other buildings line the busy square and a road branches off to the southeast.

[Academy Crossroads.]

A large marble fountain anchors the central crossroads of the academy, right at the heart of the marketplace.  Rainbow mists float through the air, reflecting any available light.  Smooth, white stone neatly paves the circular roadway encompassing the fountain.  To the north, a looming stone structure rises above the cityscape in grandiose form.  Constant traffic of locals and adventurers heading toward the north lends to the building's purpose as the academy school, while many others take advantage of the services available nearby.  You notice a wooden directional signpost.

Obvious Exits: west, east, south, and north.

[Summoner Street, Main Gate.]

The cobblestones along this end of the street do not show nearly as much wear as the ones further north near the market square.  Those traveling this far south are generally heading to, or back from, an adventure outside the protection of the academy walls to test their skills in combat.  A wrought iron lantern casts an illuminating glow over the street.  A towering stone wall extends in opposite directions from a heavy steel gate with thick steel bars making up its width.  The gate has been heavily reinforced to keep out potential invaders.  You notice a closed heavy reinforced oak door, and an open large steel gate.

[Academy Gateway.]

Towering stone walls leading in from the east and west turn sharply toward the north where they are joined by a large steel gate.  Above, guards can be seen patrolling along either side of the gate, constantly monitoring the steady flow of traffic into and out of the academy.  You notice an open large steel gate, and a weathered wooden sign with the word "WARNING" boldly engraved.

Obvious Exits: south. 




[Southland Intersection.]

The maintained roads of the academy proper come to an end where the street intersects with several pathways that provide access to the various hunting grounds that surround the area.  An iron gate stands to the south, a sign has been affixed to its detailed metalwork that warns against trespassing.  Massive trees beyond the gate block any view of what lies within.  A tall, white tower can be seen in the northern sky.  You notice an open intricately detailed iron gate, and a wooden directional signpost.

Obvious Exits: southwest, southeast, and north. 




[Phantom Lane, Gate.]

Overgrown grass and weeds line either side of the cobblestone road.  The gate that quarantines this area has been engraved with hundreds of angelic figures which all appear to be fleeing in the same northern direction.  A rusty sewer grate sits to the side of the road, below the gate.  Trees block much of the view beyond the vegetation.  Besides the wind rustling the trees, an eerie silence engulfs the route.  You notice an open rusty iron sewer grate, and an open intricately detailed iron gate.

Obvious Exits: south. 




[Phantom Lane.]

The large dark-gray wooden manor sticks out from atop the trees in the distance to the southeast.  The cobblestone road is hardly visible beneath the dense grass and weeds.  Judging by the silence, it seems there aren't any animals living within the vegetation.  A wrought iron lantern illuminating the road is here.

Obvious Exits: south, and north. 




[Phantom Lane.]

To the east lies a decrepit manor that looks aged.  The grounds haven't been maintained in many years and the building looks like it is about to collapse in on itself.  The eerie silence that blankets the route has been joined by the sound of bones knocking together every so often.

Obvious Exits: south, and north. 




[Phantom Lane.]

The lane darkens as it passes a wrought iron gate nestled in the foliage a bit to the east.  The short path to the gate is barely visible as it cuts through thick brush.

Obvious Exits: east, south, and north.

[Academy Crossroads.]

A large marble fountain anchors the central crossroads of the academy, right at the heart of the marketplace.  Rainbow mists float through the air, reflecting any available light.  Smooth, white stone neatly paves the circular roadway encompassing the fountain.  To the north, a looming stone structure rises above the cityscape in grandiose form.  Constant traffic of locals and adventurers heading toward the north lends to the building's purpose as the academy school, while many others take advantage of the services available nearby.  You notice a wooden directional signpost.

[Southland Intersection.]

The maintained roads of the academy proper come to an end where the street intersects with several pathways that provide access to the various hunting grounds that surround the area. [Academy Gateway.]

You notice an open large steel gate, and a weathered wooden sign with the word "WARNING" boldly engraved.

The eastern end of the market is covered in heavy traffic between the academy depository to the north and Sedrin's pawnshop to the south. [Academy Crossroads.]

A large marble fountain anchors the central crossroads of the academy, right at the heart of the marketplace.  Rainbow mists float through the air, reflecting any available light.  Smooth, white stone neatly paves the circular roadway encompassing the fountain.  To the north, a looming stone structure rises above the cityscape in grandiose form.  Constant traffic of locals and adventurers heading toward the north lends to the building's purpose as the academy school, while many others take advantage of the services available nearby.  You notice a wooden directional signpost.

[Market Square West.]

The square extends off in nearly every direction, each path leading to a building that provides a different and unique service from the other.

[Summoner Street, Main Gate.]

The cobblestones along this end of the street do not show nearly as much wear as the ones further north near the market square.  Those traveling this far south are generally heading to, or back from, an adventure outside the protection of the academy walls to test their skills in combat.  A wrought iron lantern casts an illuminating glow over the street.  A towering stone wall extends in opposite directions from a heavy steel gate with thick steel bars making up its width.  The gate has been heavily reinforced to keep out potential invaders.  You notice a closed heavy reinforced oak door, and an open large steel gate.

Obvious Exits: north. 




[Academy Gateway.]

Towering stone walls leading in from the east and west turn sharply toward the north where they are joined by a large steel gate.  Above, guards can be seen patrolling along either side of the gate, constantly monitoring the steady flow of traffic into and out of the academy.  You notice an open large steel gate, and a weathered wooden sign with the word "WARNING" boldly engraved.

Obvious Exits: south. 




[Southland Intersection.]

The maintained roads of the academy proper come to an end where the street intersects with several pathways that provide access to the various hunting grounds that surround the area.  An iron gate stands to the south, a sign has been affixed to its detailed metalwork that warns against trespassing.  Massive trees beyond the gate block any view of what lies within.  A tall, white tower can be seen in the northern sky.  You notice an open intricately detailed iron gate, and a wooden directional signpost.

Obvious Exits: southwest, southeast, and north. 




[Phantom Lane, Gate.]

Overgrown grass and weeds line either side of the cobblestone road.  The gate that quarantines this area has been engraved with hundreds of angelic figures which all appear to be fleeing in the same northern direction.  A rusty sewer grate sits to the side of the road, below the gate.  Trees block much of the view beyond the vegetation.  Besides the wind rustling the trees, an eerie silence engulfs the route.  You notice an open rusty iron sewer grate, and an open intricately detailed iron gate.

Obvious Exits: south. 




[Phantom Lane.]

The large dark-gray wooden manor sticks out from atop the trees in the distance to the southeast.  The cobblestone road is hardly visible beneath the dense grass and weeds.  Judging by the silence, it seems there aren't any animals living within the vegetation.  A wrought iron lantern illuminating the road is here.

Obvious Exits: south, and north. 




[Phantom Lane.]

To the east lies a decrepit manor that looks aged.  The grounds haven't been maintained in many years and the building looks like it is about to collapse in on itself.  The eerie silence that blankets the route has been joined by the sound of bones knocking together every so often.

Obvious Exits: south, and north. 




[Phantom Lane.]

Obvious Exits: east, south, and north.
